## What's new

- **Send a page to Dowlio.** Press ⌥⇧D on a page with a video, or choose Send this page to Dowlio in Dowlio Connect. Dowlio lists every video it finds, with each quality, its size and an audio-only choice. It works on X, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky, Tumblr, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Snapchat and many video sites.
- **Streams download as one file.** HLS and DASH videos arrive as one MP4, with separate video and audio joined. DRM-protected media is refused with a clear message.
- **Updates from inside Dowlio.** Dowlio checks once a day, and Check for Updates in the Dowlio menu checks now. Settings › General can turn the daily check off.
- **Safer browser pairing.** Pairing a browser now takes a 6-digit code that Dowlio shows and you type into Dowlio Connect. Dowlio and Dowlio Connect prove who they are each time they connect, and each cookie goes only to the site it belongs to.

## Before you update

- **Install this version by hand.** Dowlio 0.2.0 can't update itself, so download the DMG below once. Later versions arrive through Dowlio.
- **Allow the keychain prompt.** After this install, and after each update until Dowlio is signed with an Apple Developer ID, macOS asks once whether Dowlio may read its saved browser pairings. Choose Always Allow. Your browsers stay paired.
- **Dowlio Connect updates itself.** Browsers you already paired reload Dowlio Connect on their own and stay connected.
- **"Then: Open the file" is gone.** A download that finished on its own no longer opens by itself. If you had chosen Open, Dowlio now does nothing, and the notification's Open button still works.
